about_the_game:
"Echoes of Adventure" is a soundtrack created with classic, story-driven RPGs in mind.
It features a modern take on nostalgic game music, blending retro charm with contemporary polish.

A key feature of this collection is the recurring use of a central thematic motif across several tracks, allowing for a more cohesive and immersive musical experience throughout your game.

*******************************************

Audio Files: 10 Tracks

*******************************************

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
